title: Qlik Sense Permission and Role Change Audit
app: Qlik Sense logs via UF; QRS API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:proxy (object_type="*security*" OR action="*role*")
| stats count as changes, values(action) as actions by user_id
| sort - changes
description: Audits Qlik Sense events that grant, revoke or modify permissions and roles, giving a change trail for least-privilege reviews and incident investigation.
value: Unreviewed permission changes are a leading cause of data-access incidents; an audit trail for Qlik Sense supports governance and rollback.
implementation: Ingest Qlik Sense admin/audit events; schedule daily and alert on privilege grants made outside an approved change window.
visualization: Table of actor by change count with actions, timeline.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who changes access and permissions in Qlik Sense so unexpected changes can be traced.
